maya: new contributor hit a packaging snag while trying to run the python sample-app in CI. Local `poetry install` works but CI using exported reqs fails with weird wheel metadata.
rico: what error?
maya: ImportError: attempted relative import beyond top-level in a generated stub module. stacktrace points to redwood_sdk._compat but that file is missing in the installed wheel.
ryan: maybe the wheel build step excluded generated files. How are you exporting?
maya: we run `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o reqs.txt` and CI does `pip install -r reqs.txt`. The wheel on our internal registry has filename redwood_sdk-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl but when inspected it's missing `_compat.py` and some `.pyi` files.
nina: artifactory again? ops-bot, any cache events?
ops-bot: mirror alert: artifact redwood_sdk-0.1.0 wheel checksum mismatch detected; serving cached copy. Ticket INFRA-992 opened.
rico: can you try `pip download --no-binary :all: redwood-sdk==0.1.0` in CI or `pip install --no-binary :all: -r reqs.txt` to force sdist?
maya: tried `--no-binary :all:` but sdist build on CI uses older build tools and fails. Short-term hack: prebuild wheel locally in CI with `python -m build` and install from dist.
ryan: that's brittle. Two suggestions: 1) add explicit include entries in pyproject to ensure generated files are packaged. Example snippet: ```[tool.poetry.include]
"src/redwood_sdk/_compat.py"
"src/redwood_sdk/*.pyi"``` 2) add a packaging check in CI that builds wheel in a fresh venv and verifies `python -c "import redwood_sdk._compat"` succeeds.
nina: also consider switching sample-app CI to use `pip-tools` or `pip-compile` workflow: maintain a pinned constraints.txt that CI installs with `pip install -r constraints.txt -c constraints.txt` to avoid registry surprises.
sam: note: pip-compile helps but doesn't fix bad wheels in the mirror. Infra needs to evict corrupted artifacts.
ops-bot: INFRA-992 updated: manual purge scheduled and mirror re-sync started.
maya: created PR in sample-app to add the pre-check script and to change CI to pre-build wheel then `pip install dist/*.whl` until infra confirms mirror healthy: https://github.com/redwood/sample-app/pull/98
rico: filing SDK issue to add package-data test and update pyproject default to include stubs: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/issues/339
ryan: also adding a small note in onboarding README under "Packaging pitfalls" about editable installs/pipx vs poetry and recommended CI commands: ```python -m pip install --upgrade pip build setuptools wheel
python -m build -w -o dist
pip install dist/*.whl```
maya: thanks. temporary CI lane passing. will update thread when infra confirms permanent fix. :white_check_mark:
